description: What the account's agents did, newest first: each run with its agent, status, the tools it called, agent credits used and any error. Read the run's conversation with get_agent_conversation for the full answer.

since.description: Optional ISO date or date-time, with or without an offset, or 'today' (UTC).

status.description: Optional run status, for example completed, failed, blocked.

until.description: Optional ISO date or date-time, with or without an offset. A date alone includes that whole day (UTC).

name: list_agent_activity
title: List Agent Activity
